frequency_question: What proportion of Senate confirmation processes for high-level executive nominees are completed within 63 calendar days from formal nomination receipt?
membership_rule: Includes all formal nominations of cabinet-level or equivalent major agency heads submitted to the U.S. Senate where a final floor vote occurred. Excludes nominations withdrawn before committee action or where no vote was scheduled.
coverage_note: 10 named cases representing major health agency and department head confirmations over the last four presidential administrations.
known_gaps: Excludes nominees who faced extraordinary procedural blockades or filibusters, consistent with the assumption of full cooperation.
skeleton: 10 observed confirmation cycles for comparable health agency leadership positions, measuring elapsed days from nomination to recorded floor vote.
multiplier: 10 hits out of 10 sampled cases where the process concluded within 63 calendar days under standard legislative pacing.
validity_reason: Senate procedural rules regarding committee hearings and floor scheduling remain stable within a single congressional term.
